title: Grateful Dead Live at Golden Hall, Community Concourse on 1982-02-19
lineage: MAC (Recorded by Steven Martin, modified Nakamichi CM-700 mics > Sony TC-D5M on Maxell metal tape) > Nak Dragon playback > Cardas audiophile cables > HHB CDR 800 master CD > Plextor PX-708A extraction (EAC v0.95 prebeta 5) > tracking (CD Wav

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture with standout Phil bass and a smoking Space > The Other One second set.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as the best‑sounding copy on the archive, with clear separation that lets listeners hear Phil’s bass clearly. The show itself is described as well played, especially the second‑set Space > The Other One sequence which is called a great version with Phil “all over the place.” Overall the performance feels like a strong kickoff to the new year.

ai_rating.rationale: Review highlights an excellent second‑set and very good sound quality (4/5), but only one brief review limits certainty.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, crisp mix; Phil’s bass is especially audible; described as the best‑sounding copy on the archive.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set highlighted by a seamless, high‑energy transition from Space into The Other One; overall well‑played show.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass is prominent and “all over the place” on the Space/Other One segment.
